cata.definition:

   prefix to signify down, downward, under, against, contrary or opposed
   to, wholly, completely; as in cataclysm, catarrh. It sometimes drops

   in cathartic, catholic.

catastrophic creep.translation: [化] 灾变蠕变; 致毁蠕变

catastrophic failure.translation:
[计] 灾难性故障
[化] 灾害性破坏

catastrophic illness.translation: [网络] 灾难性疾病；重大伤病

catastrophism.definition:
n. The doctrine that the geological changes in the
   earth's crust have been caused by the sudden action of violent physical
   causes; -- opposed to the doctrine of uniformism.

catastrophist.definition: n. One who holds the theory or catastrophism.
catastrophist.translation: n. 劫数难逃论者, 灾变说者

catastrophists.definition:
plural of catastrophist
n. One who holds the theory or catastrophism.
catastrophists.translation: (catastrophist 的复数) n. 劫数难逃论者, 灾变说者

catastrophize.translation: vi. 小题大作, 小事大做, 把小问题当作大灾祸

catastrophizing.translation: (catastrophize 的现在分词) vi. 小题大作, 小事大做, 把小问题当作大灾祸

catathecium.translation: 倒子囊壳, 倒盾状囊壳

catathermometer.translation: 干湿球温度表, 卡他表

catathymia.translation: 感情迸发, 感情浮现

catathymic.translation: [医] 感情并发的, 感情浮现的

catatonia.definition: n. extreme tonus; muscular rigidity; a common symptom in catatonic schizophrenia
catatonia.translation:
n. 紧张症
[医] 紧张症

catatonic.definition: a. characterized by catatonia especially either rigidity or extreme laxness of limbs
catatonic.translation:
a. 紧张症的
n. 紧张症患者

catatonic type schizophrenia.translation: [网络] 紧张型精神分裂症

catawba.definition:
n. a member of the Siouan people formerly living in the Carolinas
n. slipskin grape; a reddish American table grape
n. the Siouan language spoken by the Catawba
catawba.translation: n. 卡托巴葡萄（产于美国东部）；卡托巴红葡萄酒

catawbas.definition:
n. pl. An Appalachian tribe of Indians which originally
   inhabited the regions near the Catawba river and the head waters of the
   Santee.
catawbas.translation: n. 卡托巴葡萄（产于美国东部）；卡托巴红葡萄酒
